'''Andy Chidester''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Orland Park tournament]] on 27 May 2001 with tractor beam deck and [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue the Princess]], according to . "Ulaire Fred" .'s tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2382">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-orland-park-il-05-27-01d2382/ orland-park-il-05-27-01], DeckTech (. "Ulaire Fred" ., 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-orland-park-il-05-27-01d2382/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
